extraction_warnings: This is an Executive Agency AER (not a Legislative AER). Section I covers executive agency decisions rather than bills/resolutions — no positions emitted because the source states 'No agency decisions'. The schema's LobbyingPosition.bill_reference is oriented toward legislation; executive agency decisions have no equivalent slot.

Reporting period label is 'Jan-Apr26', interpreted as 2026-01-01 through 2026-04-30. Ohio executive AER windows do not perfectly match the legislative quarterly windows; exact start/end dates are inferred from the period label and the May 5 filing date.
